abo_vm_test_case.tc_description:
Test Case Title: Positive Flow - Complete Form Entry and All Navigations
Module: Form Controls and Navigation
Priority: High

Preconditions:
- - User is logged in and on the main form screen of the application.
- - Application is installed and launched on a compatible iOS device.

Test Steps:
1. Wait until the Full Name field is visible.
2. Enter "DemoFull" in the Full Name field.
3. Wait for 2 seconds.
4. Enter "DemoFirst" in the First Name field.
5. Wait until the Done button on the keyboard is visible.
6. Tap the Done button on the keyboard.
7. Wait until the Clear button is visible.
8. Tap the Clear button.
9. Tap on the Controls tab.
10. Wait until the Male option is visible.
11. Tap on the Female radio button.
12. Tap on the Screens tab.
13. Wait until the Open Modal Sheet option is visible.
14. Tap on Open Modal Sheet.
15. Wait until the Close button is visible.
16. Swipe down to dismiss the modal sheet.
17. Wait until the Open Detail Screen is visible.
18. Wait for 2 seconds.
19. Tap on Open Detail Screen.
20. Wait until the Push Another Screen button is visible.
21. Tap on Push Another Screen.
22. Wait until the Nested Detail screen is visible.
23. Tap on the Back navigation button.
24. Wait until the Detail Screen is visible.
25. Tap on the Back navigation button.
26. Wait for 2 seconds.
27. Tap on the Form tab.

Expected Result:
- - Full Name and First Name fields accept input without errors.
- - 'Done' button dismisses the keyboard.
- - 'Clear' button clears the form fields.
- - Radio button selection is updated to Female.
- - Modal sheet opens and can be dismissed.
- - Detail and nested detail screens are accessible and navigable.
- - Back navigation correctly returns user to previous screens.
- - Application remains stable and responsive throughout the process. (Generated from Manual Test Case)
